finding_key: packages/sheets/test/sheet/decimals.test.ts::`expect(() => sheet.todisplaystring(...)).not.tothrow()` is vacuous — todisplaystring is async so it can never throw synchronously
evidence: In packages/sheets/test/sheet/decimals.test.ts, the clamp test asserts `expect(() => sheet.toDisplayString(...)).not.toThrow()`. Every other call site in the diff awaits `sheet.toDisplayString(...)` (e.g. lines 22, 39, and the following test), confirming it returns a Promise — it must be async since it reads the cell from the async store before formatting. An Intl RangeError would therefore reject asynchronously, so `.not.toThrow()` passes unconditionally, making the assertion vacuous exactly as claimed. Severity is minor rather than major because the immediately following test properly awaits the dp:400 case and asserts the clamped output, and format.test.ts covers hostile inputs directly, so real coverage of the behavior exists.
